description: Searches VertoDigital's full case-study library (mostly B2B technology clients in cybersecurity, data platforms, FinTech, GTM SaaS, cloud infrastructure and more, plus consumer services brands in lending and education) and returns the matching case studies as markdown, grouped under their industry headings. Each match is one line: the headline result as a link of the form https://vertodigital.com/markdown/case-studies/<slug>.md (pass it to vertodigital_get_page for the full write-up), then a one-sentence summary naming the client, what was done (including the CRM or platform, such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Marketo, where it mattered) and the results. Use it to find a specific client, or every result in an industry, channel or tool; to find other kinds of pages (services, blog posts, events), use vertodigital_get_site_index, and for a short, curated set of flagship proof points tied to a buyer's challenge, use vertodigital_get_value_proposition with aspect: "proof_points" instead. A case study matches when every word of query starts a word in its title, summary or industry heading (case-insensitive, so "attribut" finds "attribution" and "LinkedIn fintech" finds LinkedIn work for FinTech clients), so one or two keywords find more than a sentence; no match returns match_count: 0 with a hint, not an error. Omit query for the whole library page (roughly 10 KB). Fetched live on every call.

query.description: One or two keywords: client name, industry, service, tool, or outcome. Examples: "cybersecurity", "LinkedIn", "SnapLogic", "HubSpot", "pipeline", "SEO". Omit to return the full list of case studies.

name: vertodigital_search_case_studies

markdown.description: The document as markdown - identical to the text content block.

match_count.description: Number of matching case studies - present when query was given

query.description: The filter keyword that was applied, or null for the full list
